verdict.rationale: Dover is a SaaS recruiting platform, and self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only the hosted API, webhooks, a hosted HTTP MCP server, and CSV export. None of it documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product, and these adjacent openness features earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
